dedupe_keys.name: aem monthly us agricultural tractor and combine sales reports

description: The Association of Equipment Manufacturers publishes monthly reports of US unit retail sales of agricultural tractors and combines, compiling the previous month's sales; the report for August 2026 was the latest at access, and a companion series covers Canada. AEM is a trade association of more than 1,000 equipment manufacturers. Coverage is the United States at national level. The latest report is free to download from the AEM website after release through a newswire, while subscribers can buy an email service that delivers reports minutes after release, and reprints of historical reports for a chosen period are sold through the AEM store. The reports are copyright AEM with all rights reserved, and users are asked to acknowledge AEM when citing the figures. Caveats: the page read does not give the size classes reported or how sales are collected, and long historical series are paid. For simulation it tracks how quickly the farm machinery fleet is renewed, useful for capacity planning of agricultural production and for estimating equipment replacement demand after disasters such as floods or derechos. It is related to the CARB agricultural equipment emission inventory record in this catalogue, which estimates the equipment population in California.
